entities.name: BH RLC Channel Configuration
entities.description: Procedure for adding or modifying Backhaul RLC channels in an IAB-node based on received configuration.

entities.name: bh-RLC-ChannelToAddModList IE
entities.description: Information element containing configuration for BH RLC channels to be added or modified.

entities.name: bh-RLC-ChannelID
entities.description: Identifier for a specific BH RLC channel within a cell group.

entities.name: RLC Entity
entities.description: Radio Link Control entity that handles data transmission over the radio interface.

entities.name: Logical Channel
entities.description: MAC layer logical channel configured for data transport.

entities.name: rlc-Config
entities.description: Configuration parameters for RLC entity setup and reconfiguration.

entities.name: mac-LogicalChannelConfig
entities.description: Configuration parameters for MAC logical channel setup and reconfiguration.

entities.name: reestablishRLC
entities.description: Condition indicating that the RLC entity should be re-established.

entities.name: Existing BH RLC Channel
entities.description: Condition where a BH RLC channel with the same ID already exists in the current configuration.

entities.name: New BH RLC Channel
entities.description: Condition where a BH RLC channel with the given ID was not previously configured.

relations.description: The BH RLC channel configuration procedure uses the bh-RLC-ChannelToAddModList IE.
The bh-RLC-ChannelToAddModList IE contains bh-RLC-ChannelID identifiers.
The procedure behavior is guarded by whether an existing BH RLC channel with the same ID is present.
For existing channels, the reestablishRLC condition determines if RLC re-establishment is needed.
When reestablishRLC is received, the RLC entity is re-established as per TS 38.322.
For existing channels, the RLC entity is reconfigured according to rlc-Config.
For existing channels, the logical channel is reconfigured according to mac-LogicalChannelConfig.
The procedure behavior is guarded by whether the BH RLC channel is new.
For new channels, an RLC entity is established according to rlc-Config.
For new channels, a logical channel is configured according to mac-LogicalChannelConfig.
The bh-RLC-ChannelToAddModList IE contains rlc-Config parameters.
The bh-RLC-ChannelToAddModList IE contains mac-LogicalChannelConfig parameters.
